scenes.topic: Grant reports without the quarter-end scramble
scenes.vo: Priya, I put this short video together for you, about grant reporting at Riverbend Family Shelter.

scenes.headline: Every quarter, the *numbers* get rebuilt by hand.
lines: Services logged in one place, demographics in another
VOCA, FVPSA and HUD each want them their own way
scenes.vo: Most shelters rebuild their funder numbers by hand every quarter, from services logged in one place and demographics in another.
Here's what that looks like in NECX, with your agency's name on it.
In NECX, every case is tagged to the grant that funds it, so services count toward the right grant from day one.
For VOCA, NECX builds the OVC PMT screen sheet from your logged services, and checks it against OVC's own rules before sign-off.
Click Explain to see every record behind a number, and anything left out.

scenes.headline: Less rebuilding. More *confidence.*
items: Every case tagged to its grant
scenes.vo: Every case tagged to its grant, checked before you certify, and every number explained.
